def init():
    return dict(phase=0, count=0, byte=0, tx=1, div=868)


def step(state, inputs):
    outputs = dict()

    div = state.get("div", 868)
    if div < 1:
        div = 1

    if inputs.get("rst", 0) != 0:
        state["phase"] = 0
        state["count"] = 0
        state["byte"] = 0
        state["tx"] = 1
    elif state.get("phase", 0) == 0:
        state["byte"] = inputs.get("data", 0) & 255
        state["phase"] = 1
        state["count"] = div - 1
        state["tx"] = 0
    elif state.get("count", 0) > 0:
        state["count"] = state.get("count", 0) - 1
    elif state.get("phase", 0) < 9:
        state["phase"] = state.get("phase", 0) + 1
        state["count"] = div - 1
        outputs["tx"] = (state.get("byte", 0) >> (state.get("phase", 0) - 2)) & 1
        state["tx"] = outputs["tx"]
    elif state.get("phase", 0) == 9:
        state["phase"] = 10
        state["count"] = div - 1
        state["tx"] = 1
    else:
        state["phase"] = 0
        state["count"] = 0
        state["tx"] = 1

    outputs["tx"] = state.get("tx", 1) & 1
    return state, outputs
